query_text: 我想找一家环境安静、可以轻松聊天的餐厅，有什么推荐吗？
requirement_text: 评论需要说明这家餐厅的环境是否足够安静、顾客能否不用提高音量就正常交谈。
evidence_span: We were sitting upstairs and it was really quiet which was great cause we could easily talk.
evidence_context: Great atmosphere, food and drinks. We were sitting upstairs and it was really quiet which was great cause we could easily talk. Everyone was really nice to us, no complaints

query_text: 有没有比较清静的馆子？我们几个人吃饭时想坐下来好好聊聊天。
requirement_text: 评论里要直接写明店内环境是否安静、说话是否轻松。
evidence_span: This place was fine when my friend and I were the only ones in the restaurant
evidence_context: This place was fine when my friend and I were the only ones in the restaurant; then when the place began to fill up it became so loud that it was truly unbearable.  It was so noisy that we had to shout at each other from across our two-top and eventually stopped our conversation altogether. Mediocre food, mediocre service, unacceptably loud.  Will not be returning.

query_text: 帮忙推荐个安静点的餐厅吧，吃饭的时候不想被吵得没法说话。
requirement_text: 评论需要直接说明餐厅噪音情况，以及顾客之间能否听清对方说话。
evidence_span: the restaurant noise was so loud we could not hear each other
evidence_context: There were 6 of us for dinner last night and the food and service was wonderful.  Unfortunately the restaurant noise was so loud we could not hear each other, ended up passing on dessert as we could not stand the noise.

query_text: 我在找一家安静平和、适合边吃边谈事情的餐馆，哪家合适？
requirement_text: 评论必须明确写出店里是不是太吵、能不能听清同伴讲话。
evidence_span: Good food but VERY NOISY. I could not hear my dinner companion.
evidence_context: Good food but VERY NOISY. I could not hear my dinner companion. Went home with a huge headache, but food and drinks were good.
